s: Commonly, an upper bound of a set $S$ of real numbers is a number $b$ such that for all $x\in S$ one has $x\leq b$. The least upper bound of $S$ is then defined as an upper bound $B$ such that for every upper bound $b$ one has $B\leq b$.
